units.displayText: The Oasis, temporary command center.

units.rawText: Control point established, neural connections confirmed, operand-powered hydraulics inspection complete, mobility recognition equipment updated... energy output normal... sigh...
units.displayText: Control point established, neural connections confirmed, operand-powered hydraulics inspection complete, mobility recognition equipment updated... energy output normal... sigh...

spans.text: Control point established, neural connections confirmed, operand-powered hydraulics inspection complete, mobility recognition equipment updated... energy output normal... sigh...

units.rawText: Working away at the interface in front of her, Antonina sighs again.
units.displayText: Working away at the interface in front of her, Antonina sighs again.

spans.text: Working away at the interface in front of her, Antonina sighs again.

units.rawText: Why're you always sighing, Anna? Sighing all the time...
units.displayText: Why're you always sighing, Anna? Sighing all the time...

spans.text: Why're you always sighing, Anna? Sighing all the time...

units.rawText: Yeah, yeah... It sighs the happiness away...
units.displayText: Yeah, yeah... It sighs the happiness away...

spans.text: Yeah, yeah... It sighs the happiness away...

units.rawText: Wow... sure is Anna, already cutting me off. Something you're worried about?
units.displayText: Wow... sure is Anna, already cutting me off. Something you're worried about?

spans.text: Wow... sure is Anna, already cutting me off. Something you're worried about?

units.rawText: At the sight of Sol's mischievous expression, Antonina felt the need to sigh once more.
units.displayText: At the sight of Sol's mischievous expression, Antonina felt the need to sigh once more.

spans.text: At the sight of Sol's mischievous expression, Antonina felt the need to sigh once more.

units.rawText: Sigh... I just wanted to say that that one really got into your heads. Even Persicaria is considering a tactic this dangerous.
units.displayText: Sigh... I just wanted to say that that one really got into your heads. Even Persicaria is considering a tactic this dangerous.

spans.text: Sigh... I just wanted to say that that one really got into your heads. Even Persicaria is considering a tactic this dangerous.

units.rawText: But didn't you agree to help, Anna? Don't you also think the Professor... whoa! Too tight! Too tight!
units.displayText: But didn't you agree to help, Anna? Don't you also think the Professor... whoa! Too tight! Too tight!

spans.text: But didn't you agree to help, Anna? Don't you also think the Professor... whoa! Too tight! Too tight!

units.rawText: Antonina abruptly picks up a vambrace, placing it over Sol's arm. She pulls hard on the straps, eliciting a pained wail from Sol.
units.displayText: Antonina abruptly picks up a vambrace, placing it over Sol's arm. She pulls hard on the straps, eliciting a pained wail from Sol.

spans.text: Antonina abruptly picks up a vambrace, placing it over Sol's arm. She pulls hard on the straps, eliciting a pained wail from Sol.

units.rawText: Don't move. Let me adjust this...
units.displayText: Don't move. Let me adjust this...

spans.text: Don't move. Let me adjust this...

units.rawText: Antonina looks back and forth between her terminal and equipment. As numbers move up and down, the formerly compact piece of armor moves into a more appropriate position.
units.displayText: Antonina looks back and forth between her terminal and equipment. As numbers move up and down, the formerly compact piece of armor moves into a more appropriate position.

spans.text: Antonina looks back and forth between her terminal and equipment. As numbers move up and down, the formerly compact piece of armor moves into a more appropriate position.

units.rawText: If we didn't have this rig made by Croque and Zion, I'd never agree to these suicidal methods.
units.displayText: If we didn't have this rig made by Croque and Zion, I'd never agree to these suicidal methods.

spans.text: If we didn't have this rig made by Croque and Zion, I'd never agree to these suicidal methods.

units.rawText: Alright, everything seems to be in the green... try it on.
units.displayText: Alright, everything seems to be in the green... try it on.

spans.text: Alright, everything seems to be in the green... try it on.

units.rawText: Woah! Is this Croque's Full-Armor Exoskeleton ZZ? Really does fill me with strength.
units.displayText: Woah! Is this Croque's Full-Armor Exoskeleton ZZ? Really does fill me with strength.

spans.text: Woah! Is this Croque's Full-Armor Exoskeleton ZZ? Really does fill me with strength.

units.rawText: This suit'll project a defense field for you so you can move properly in the high-operand density environment.
units.displayText: This suit'll project a defense field for you so you can move properly in the high-operand density environment.

spans.text: This suit'll project a defense field for you so you can move properly in the high-operand density environment.

units.rawText: Are you ready?
units.displayText: Are you ready?

spans.text: Are you ready?

units.rawText: Persicaria, you're here! See, isn't this cool?
units.displayText: Persicaria, you're here! See, isn't this cool?

spans.text: Persicaria, you're here! See, isn't this cool?

units.rawText: How does the exoskeleton feel? I hope there aren't any issues in case of emergency...
units.displayText: How does the exoskeleton feel? I hope there aren't any issues in case of emergency...

spans.text: How does the exoskeleton feel? I hope there aren't any issues in case of emergency...

units.rawText: I'm fully adjusted! Look, I... uhhh...
units.displayText: I'm fully adjusted! Look, I... uhhh...

spans.text: I'm fully adjusted! Look, I... uhhh...

units.rawText: Sol attempts to windmill her arm, but the exoskeleton's joints protest loudly, not exactly obedient to Sol's wishes.
units.displayText: Sol attempts to windmill her arm, but the exoskeleton's joints protest loudly, not exactly obedient to Sol's wishes.

spans.text: Sol attempts to windmill her arm, but the exoskeleton's joints protest loudly, not exactly obedient to Sol's wishes.

units.rawText: The exoskeleton'll save you from the operands, but it'll need time to sync up properly with your movement.
units.displayText: The exoskeleton'll save you from the operands, but it'll need time to sync up properly with your movement.

spans.text: The exoskeleton'll save you from the operands, but it'll need time to sync up properly with your movement.

units.rawText: Antonina's right. Make yourself more compatible with the equipment while you can. We'll need every edge we can get.
units.displayText: Antonina's right. Make yourself more compatible with the equipment while you can. We'll need every edge we can get.

spans.text: Antonina's right. Make yourself more compatible with the equipment while you can. We'll need every edge we can get.

units.rawText: Oh... right, we'll need to wait for Lind's signal anyway.
units.displayText: Oh... right, we'll need to wait for Lind's signal anyway.

spans.text: Oh... right, we'll need to wait for Lind's signal anyway.

units.rawText:
Yeah, so you'd better sit still here. It won't be long, just a few minutes.
Persicaria, you talked with the Professor?
units.displayText:
Yeah, so you'd better sit still here. It won't be long, just a few minutes.
Persicaria, you talked with the Professor?

spans.text:
Yeah, so you'd better sit still here. It won't be long, just a few minutes.
Persicaria, you talked with the Professor?

units.rawText: I did. The Professor has shown their support for our plan. And just in case, we can contact Croque to start up the railgun.
units.displayText: I did. The Professor has shown their support for our plan. And just in case, we can contact Croque to start up the railgun.

spans.text: I did. The Professor has shown their support for our plan. And just in case, we can contact Croque to start up the railgun.

units.rawText:
The railgun... it's back in our hands?
Quite impressive.
units.displayText:
The railgun... it's back in our hands?
Quite impressive.

spans.text:
The railgun... it's back in our hands?
Quite impressive.

units.rawText: Though we shouldn't use it unless if we really have to, right? Doesn't feel like the Oasis can survive another one of those hits...
units.displayText: Though we shouldn't use it unless if we really have to, right? Doesn't feel like the Oasis can survive another one of those hits...

spans.text: Though we shouldn't use it unless if we really have to, right? Doesn't feel like the Oasis can survive another one of those hits...

units.rawText: It is always good to have a card up one's sleeve. Give me a moment.
units.displayText: It is always good to have a card up one's sleeve. Give me a moment.

spans.text: It is always good to have a card up one's sleeve. Give me a moment.

units.rawText: As she speaks, Antonina produces something and begins to fiddle with it.
units.displayText: As she speaks, Antonina produces something and begins to fiddle with it.

spans.text: As she speaks, Antonina produces something and begins to fiddle with it.

units.rawText: Let's hope we're successful.
units.displayText: Let's hope we're successful.

spans.text: Let's hope we're successful.

units.rawText: Retreat if the situation becomes dire, understand?
units.displayText: Retreat if the situation becomes dire, understand?

spans.text: Retreat if the situation becomes dire, understand?

units.rawText: Yeah, yeah, I know.
units.displayText: Yeah, yeah, I know.

spans.text: Yeah, yeah, I know.

units.rawText: There... we go!
units.displayText: There... we go!

spans.text: There... we go!

units.rawText: Antonina chucks the object in her hand at Sol.
units.displayText: Antonina chucks the object in her hand at Sol.

spans.text: Antonina chucks the object in her hand at Sol.

units.rawText: Woah! This... isn't this a bomb?! Is it really ok to throw it like that?
units.displayText: Woah! This... isn't this a bomb?! Is it really ok to throw it like that?

spans.text: Woah! This... isn't this a bomb?! Is it really ok to throw it like that?

units.rawText: This thing itself won't deal much damage to Ptolemaea, but I've added a control program inside of it.
units.displayText: This thing itself won't deal much damage to Ptolemaea, but I've added a control program inside of it.

spans.text: This thing itself won't deal much damage to Ptolemaea, but I've added a control program inside of it.

units.rawText: It should hold Ptolemaea still for around 20 seconds, which should be enough for you to escape the field...
units.displayText: It should hold Ptolemaea still for around 20 seconds, which should be enough for you to escape the field...

spans.text: It should hold Ptolemaea still for around 20 seconds, which should be enough for you to escape the field...

units.rawText: Anna.
units.displayText: Anna.

spans.text: Anna.

units.rawText: Before Anna had finished her explanation, Sol extended a hand towards the top of her head.
units.displayText: Before Anna had finished her explanation, Sol extended a hand towards the top of her head.

spans.text: Before Anna had finished her explanation, Sol extended a hand towards the top of her head.

units.rawText: Thank you, Anna. Don't worry!
units.displayText: Thank you, Anna. Don't worry!

spans.text: Thank you, Anna. Don't worry!

units.rawText: I'll count on you two to execute the plan.
units.displayText: I'll count on you two to execute the plan.

spans.text: I'll count on you two to execute the plan.

units.rawText: No matter how ridiculous your schemes are... I'll help you create the scenario with the greatest likelihood of success. So... trust me and this idiot over here.
units.displayText: No matter how ridiculous your schemes are... I'll help you create the scenario with the greatest likelihood of success. So... trust me and this idiot over here.

spans.text: No matter how ridiculous your schemes are... I'll help you create the scenario with the greatest likelihood of success. So... trust me and this idiot over here.

units.rawText: Yeah! Persicaria, you'd better be waiting for us with the coffee! Just like before!
units.displayText: Yeah! Persicaria, you'd better be waiting for us with the coffee! Just like before!

spans.text: Yeah! Persicaria, you'd better be waiting for us with the coffee! Just like before!

units.rawText: No... maybe with half the sugar.
units.displayText: No... maybe with half the sugar.

spans.text: No... maybe with half the sugar.

units.rawText: ...Alright!
units.displayText: ...Alright!

spans.text: ...Alright!

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at the pair in front of her.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at the pair in front of her.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at the pair in front of her.

units.rawText: Ah, and the Professor's portion, and everyone at the Oasis... and Lind's company.
units.displayText: Ah, and the Professor's portion, and everyone at the Oasis... and Lind's company.

spans.text: Ah, and the Professor's portion, and everyone at the Oasis... and Lind's company.

units.rawText: Our reserves are going to run dry. I say we bust out a bit of the Professor's pocket money to treat everyone.
units.displayText: Our reserves are going to run dry. I say we bust out a bit of the Professor's pocket money to treat everyone.

spans.text: Our reserves are going to run dry. I say we bust out a bit of the Professor's pocket money to treat everyone.

units.rawText: This is no small task...
units.displayText: This is no small task...

spans.text: This is no small task...

units.rawText: Watching the two plot to liberate the Professor of their money, Sol couldn't help but beam.
units.displayText: Watching the two plot to liberate the Professor of their money, Sol couldn't help but beam.

spans.text: Watching the two plot to liberate the Professor of their money, Sol couldn't help but beam.

units.rawText: What are you having a laugh about? I can see that expression of yours through the mask.
units.displayText: What are you having a laugh about? I can see that expression of yours through the mask.

spans.text: What are you having a laugh about? I can see that expression of yours through the mask.

units.rawText: Haha, I just... started thinking about the old days...
units.displayText: Haha, I just... started thinking about the old days...

spans.text: Haha, I just... started thinking about the old days...

units.rawText: Sol takes out the tiny bottle from the gaps in her chest plate.
units.displayText: Sol takes out the tiny bottle from the gaps in her chest plate.

spans.text: Sol takes out the tiny bottle from the gaps in her chest plate.

units.rawText: It's just as Persicaria and Knot said that day...
units.displayText: It's just as Persicaria and Knot said that day...

spans.text: It's just as Persicaria and Knot said that day...

units.rawText: Ah... that's...
units.displayText: Ah... that's...

spans.text: Ah... that's...

units.rawText: Looking at the little bottle, Persicaria seems to recall something as well.
units.displayText: Looking at the little bottle, Persicaria seems to recall something as well.

spans.text: Looking at the little bottle, Persicaria seems to recall something as well.

units.rawText: You've... always said that there was a promise inside that bottle... and would keep the grass in there alive by feeding it operands every day.
units.displayText: You've... always said that there was a promise inside that bottle... and would keep the grass in there alive by feeding it operands every day.

spans.text: You've... always said that there was a promise inside that bottle... and would keep the grass in there alive by feeding it operands every day.

units.rawText: What is that exactly? And this Lind that popped out of nowhere...
units.displayText: What is that exactly? And this Lind that popped out of nowhere...

spans.text: What is that exactly? And this Lind that popped out of nowhere...

units.rawText: It's...
units.displayText: It's...

spans.text: It's...

units.rawText: I imagine the Oasis must be like that—a place full of greenery where everyone can live without fear or worry.
units.displayText: I imagine the Oasis must be like that—a place full of greenery where everyone can live without fear or worry.

spans.text: I imagine the Oasis must be like that—a place full of greenery where everyone can live without fear or worry.

units.rawText: You think? Then I'll grow a little strand of grass in there, and we'll see whether or not the Oasis is what we imagined!
units.displayText: You think? Then I'll grow a little strand of grass in there, and we'll see whether or not the Oasis is what we imagined!

spans.text: You think? Then I'll grow a little strand of grass in there, and we'll see whether or not the Oasis is what we imagined!

units.rawText: Ah, that'd be a very long story. Back then—
units.displayText: Ah, that'd be a very long story. Back then—

spans.text: Ah, that'd be a very long story. Back then—

units.rawText: Stop! Now's not the time for that.
units.displayText: Stop! Now's not the time for that.

spans.text: Stop! Now's not the time for that.

units.rawText: Really, the one time I get to tell a story?
units.displayText: Really, the one time I get to tell a story?

spans.text: Really, the one time I get to tell a story?

units.rawText: It can wait until you get back to me in one piece.
units.displayText: It can wait until you get back to me in one piece.

spans.text: It can wait until you get back to me in one piece.

units.rawText: Antonina looks between Sol and Persicaria.
units.displayText: Antonina looks between Sol and Persicaria.

spans.text: Antonina looks between Sol and Persicaria.

units.rawText: Antonina...
units.displayText: Antonina...

spans.text: Antonina...

units.rawText: Persicaria nods, her expression grave.
units.displayText: Persicaria nods, her expression grave.

spans.text: Persicaria nods, her expression grave.

units.rawText: I understand.
units.displayText: I understand.

spans.text: I understand.

units.rawText: Beeeeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeeeep—

spans.text: Beeeeeep—

units.rawText: A rapid series of incoming messages interrupt what little time the three had to themselves.
units.displayText: A rapid series of incoming messages interrupt what little time the three had to themselves.

spans.text: A rapid series of incoming messages interrupt what little time the three had to themselves.

units.rawText: They exchange looks. It was time to move.
units.displayText: They exchange looks. It was time to move.

spans.text: They exchange looks. It was time to move.

units.rawText: This is the Guardian Squad, operation proceeding—
units.displayText: This is the Guardian Squad, operation proceeding—

spans.text: This is the Guardian Squad, operation proceeding—

units.rawText: Stop pushing it, Lind! This thing's way tougher than what we planned for!
units.displayText: Stop pushing it, Lind! This thing's way tougher than what we planned for!

spans.text: Stop pushing it, Lind! This thing's way tougher than what we planned for!

units.rawText: Fifteen minutes ago.
units.displayText: Fifteen minutes ago.

spans.text: Fifteen minutes ago.

units.rawText: Using us as bait for Ptolemaea, then deploying traps on the way to thin down the number of jellyfish... and finally mustering the operands to create a field that'll paralyze Ptolemaea.
units.displayText: Using us as bait for Ptolemaea, then deploying traps on the way to thin down the number of jellyfish... and finally mustering the operands to create a field that'll paralyze Ptolemaea.

spans.text: Using us as bait for Ptolemaea, then deploying traps on the way to thin down the number of jellyfish... and finally mustering the operands to create a field that'll paralyze Ptolemaea.

units.rawText: One hell of a plan this old friend of yours has cooked up. Feels different from what you've always described, honestly.
units.displayText: One hell of a plan this old friend of yours has cooked up. Feels different from what you've always described, honestly.

spans.text: One hell of a plan this old friend of yours has cooked up. Feels different from what you've always described, honestly.

units.rawText: Hey, hey, you're not going to give me the silent treatment until we get back, are you? You haven't said a thing since you handed over command. What's wrong?
units.displayText: Hey, hey, you're not going to give me the silent treatment until we get back, are you? You haven't said a thing since you handed over command. What's wrong?

spans.text: Hey, hey, you're not going to give me the silent treatment until we get back, are you? You haven't said a thing since you handed over command. What's wrong?

units.rawText: ...Have a lot on my mind.
units.displayText: ...Have a lot on my mind.

spans.text: ...Have a lot on my mind.

units.rawText: Ohhh, the blues... yeah, I understand. Didn't get to yell at Persicaria to your heart's desire—
units.displayText: Ohhh, the blues... yeah, I understand. Didn't get to yell at Persicaria to your heart's desire—

spans.text: Ohhh, the blues... yeah, I understand. Didn't get to yell at Persicaria to your heart's desire—

units.rawText: Shut it. I'm worried about how we'll guide Ptolemaea in.
units.displayText: Shut it. I'm worried about how we'll guide Ptolemaea in.

spans.text: Shut it. I'm worried about how we'll guide Ptolemaea in.

units.rawText: Ah, ok, ok. Do you have any good ideas? The trap's already been set by your friends, and the location of the big final battle is all set up, too.
units.displayText: Ah, ok, ok. Do you have any good ideas? The trap's already been set by your friends, and the location of the big final battle is all set up, too.

spans.text: Ah, ok, ok. Do you have any good ideas? The trap's already been set by your friends, and the location of the big final battle is all set up, too.

units.rawText: Good ideas, perhaps not, but I do have an idea.
units.displayText: Good ideas, perhaps not, but I do have an idea.

spans.text: Good ideas, perhaps not, but I do have an idea.

units.rawText: Yeah?
units.displayText: Yeah?

spans.text: Yeah?

units.rawText: Lind lays her hand on the somewhat warm Entropic core embedded in her chest.
units.displayText: Lind lays her hand on the somewhat warm Entropic core embedded in her chest.

spans.text: Lind lays her hand on the somewhat warm Entropic core embedded in her chest.

units.rawText: Oh, come on now... you're not going to...
units.displayText: Oh, come on now... you're not going to...

spans.text: Oh, come on now... you're not going to...

units.rawText: You have any better ideas?
units.displayText: You have any better ideas?

spans.text: You have any better ideas?

units.rawText: Sigh... you're the boss.
units.displayText: Sigh... you're the boss.

spans.text: Sigh... you're the boss.

units.rawText: Seeing through Lind's plan, Havoc reluctantly picks up her shield. Trailing behind Lind, they approach that High Order Entropic, which seemed to inspire dread in the most stalwart.
units.displayText: Seeing through Lind's plan, Havoc reluctantly picks up her shield. Trailing behind Lind, they approach that High Order Entropic, which seemed to inspire dread in the most stalwart.

spans.text: Seeing through Lind's plan, Havoc reluctantly picks up her shield. Trailing behind Lind, they approach that High Order Entropic, which seemed to inspire dread in the most stalwart.

units.rawText: The Entropic named Ptolemaea turns around as if it had long previously predicted the two's movements.
units.displayText: The Entropic named Ptolemaea turns around as if it had long previously predicted the two's movements.

spans.text: The Entropic named Ptolemaea turns around as if it had long previously predicted the two's movements.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Oh? You are...</color>
units.displayText: Oh? You are...

spans.text: Oh? You are...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>How delightful. I had not intended for this performance today. I wished to retire earlier, perhaps. Never did I expect that fate would bring us together again.</color>
units.displayText: How delightful. I had not intended for this performance today. I wished to retire earlier, perhaps. Never did I expect that fate would bring us together again.

spans.text: How delightful. I had not intended for this performance today. I wished to retire earlier, perhaps. Never did I expect that fate would bring us together again.

units.rawText: Again? You just used a clone last time to take me out of the picture.
units.displayText: Again? You just used a clone last time to take me out of the picture.

spans.text: Again? You just used a clone last time to take me out of the picture.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>If you took offense to our meeting before... I must ask for your forgiveness. I never had the intention of being half-hearted...</color>
units.displayText: If you took offense to our meeting before... I must ask for your forgiveness. I never had the intention of being half-hearted...

spans.text: If you took offense to our meeting before... I must ask for your forgiveness. I never had the intention of being half-hearted...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>These children are me, and I am these children. We do not make these distinctions...</color>
units.displayText: These children are me, and I am these children. We do not make these distinctions...

spans.text: These children are me, and I am these children. We do not make these distinctions...

units.rawText: As if to verify her words, the jellyfish in her retinue lift the sides of their "skirts" in curtsy, mirroring her.
units.displayText: As if to verify her words, the jellyfish in her retinue lift the sides of their "skirts" in curtsy, mirroring her.

spans.text: As if to verify her words, the jellyfish in her retinue lift the sides of their "skirts" in curtsy, mirroring her.

units.rawText: Ahhh, this pisses me off. Never imagined that an Entropic talking all prim and proper would be this distasteful.
units.displayText: Ahhh, this pisses me off. Never imagined that an Entropic talking all prim and proper would be this distasteful.

spans.text: Ahhh, this pisses me off. Never imagined that an Entropic talking all prim and proper would be this distasteful.

units.rawText: She winds up a mechanical arm.
units.displayText: She winds up a mechanical arm.

spans.text: She winds up a mechanical arm.

units.rawText: Truth be told, I don't care to know what you have in mind.
units.displayText: Truth be told, I don't care to know what you have in mind.

spans.text: Truth be told, I don't care to know what you have in mind.

units.rawText: But I can't accept receiving a rude visitation and leave it unavenged.
units.displayText: But I can't accept receiving a rude visitation and leave it unavenged.

spans.text: But I can't accept receiving a rude visitation and leave it unavenged.

units.rawText: Fire!
units.displayText: Fire!

spans.text: Fire!

units.rawText: The Guardians unloaded into Ptolemaea with nothing left in reserve.
units.displayText: The Guardians unloaded into Ptolemaea with nothing left in reserve.

spans.text: The Guardians unloaded into Ptolemaea with nothing left in reserve.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>These sorts of moves... are so thoroughly uninteresting.</color>
units.displayText: These sorts of moves... are so thoroughly uninteresting.

spans.text: These sorts of moves... are so thoroughly uninteresting.

units.rawText: Their attacks fail to even scratch Ptolemaea as she advances, step by step.
units.displayText: Their attacks fail to even scratch Ptolemaea as she advances, step by step.

spans.text: Their attacks fail to even scratch Ptolemaea as she advances, step by step.

units.rawText: Everyone, pull back!
units.displayText: Everyone, pull back!

spans.text: Everyone, pull back!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>The ball's only just begun. Why do you seek to take your leave?</color>
units.displayText: The ball's only just begun. Why do you seek to take your leave?

units.rawText: Wha...
units.displayText: Wha...

spans.text: Wha...

units.displayText: Ptolemaea shifts her stance and accelerates, suddenly bearing down on the squad.

spans.text: Ptolemaea shifts her stance and accelerates, suddenly bearing down on the squad.

units.rawText: Crap...
units.displayText: Crap...

spans.text: Crap...

units.rawText: Havoc immediately leverages her shield as Lind supports her body. They barely endured the blow, even with their combined abilities.
units.displayText: Havoc immediately leverages her shield as Lind supports her body. They barely endured the blow, even with their combined abilities.

spans.text: Havoc immediately leverages her shield as Lind supports her body. They barely endured the blow, even with their combined abilities.

units.rawText: That speed... is on a whole other level...
units.displayText: That speed... is on a whole other level...

spans.text: That speed... is on a whole other level...
